settings.heading: New York bagel
settings.text:
Bad Boy Bagel Co. is built by people who've spent their working lives behind a bagel counter. We've been in the bagel business in New York for over 30 years, and today we run 28 retail locations.

Now we're shipping the bagels we know best — straight from our Long Island commissary to your door.
settings.image_alt: Inside the Bad Boy Bagel Co. commissary

settings.label: Years in the NY bagel business

settings.heading: Three decades of
settings.text: Thirty-plus years teaches you a few things: how a good bagel should taste, what New Yorkers will (and won't) put up with, and how to get it right every single morning.
settings.image_alt: An assortment of bagels on a white background

settings.title: Baked and shipped the same day
settings.text: your box leaves the day it's baked.

settings.title: Shipped Monday–Wednesday
settings.text: so it never sits in a warehouse over the weekend.

settings.title: No preservatives
settings.text: just bagels. Eat within 24 hours or freeze the rest.

settings.image_alt: Bagels coming out of the oven at our Long Island commissary
settings.heading: From our oven
settings.text: Every Bad Boy box is baked at our commissary on Long Island, New York. Our kosher facility runs a peanut-free process, and the same New York team that bakes your bagels is the one answering your emails.

settings.image_alt: A Bad Boy Bagel Co. box packed with four sleeves of bagels
settings.heading: Good bagels
settings.text: Plenty of people grew up on New York bagels and moved somewhere that just doesn't get it. Plenty more have never had a real one. Bad Boy Bagel Co. is how we fix that — pick your flavors, we bake and ship, and you're eating New York bagels at home.

settings.heading: Taste the 30 years.
settings.text: Four sleeves, up to four flavors, free shipping included.
